source.title: Withdrawal assessment report for Lenalidomide Celgene Europe

design.population_disease_context: renal impairment due to non-malignant conditions; healthy controls of similar age

population.summary: Subjects with renal impairment due to non-malignant conditions, mostly cardiovascular or endocrine disorders, and healthy subjects of similar age with normal renal function as controls. Not patients with myeloma or another haematological cancer.

impaired_groups.statement: renal impairment due to non-malignant conditions
impaired_groups.quote: This was an open-label, multicenter, single oral dose study in subjects with renal impairment due to nonmalignant conditions.

cause.quote: The cause of renal impairment in most of the subjects was the result of either cardiovascular and/or endocrine disorders.

normal_group.statement: healthy subjects of similar age (control group)
normal_group.quote: As a control group comparator, 7 healthy subjects of similar age with normal renal function (creatinine clearance 83-145 mL/min) were also administered a single oral 25-mg dose of REVLIMID® (lenalidomide).
normal_group.source: REVLIMID prescribing information, about December 2008 (NDA 021880 S-006/016/017)
normal_group.location: Clinical Pharmacology, Special Populations, PDF page 6

population.consequence: Comparisons of the myeloma-based models (Hughes 2019, Kim 2026) with this study test how the models extrapolate to a non-cancer renal-impairment population. This is one possible contributor to model-versus-study differences; it has not been tested.
population.review: AI-assisted; the quotes are those recorded and checked against the source files in the reconciliation file. Independent review pending.

limitations: Aggregate mean and SD only; no paired subject covariates, raw concentrations or sampling schedule extracted.
AUC infinity includes extrapolation and is not interchangeable with saved AUC 0-24 h.
Ratios of group means are descriptive; not mean individual ratios, geometric mean ratios or causal effects.
Do not replace ranges with midpoints or interpret SD as confidence intervals.
Dialysis groups are excluded from this extraction; the current model has no dialysis process.
Historical regulatory report values are not merged with publication abstract summaries.
The subjects did not have myeloma or another haematological cancer: impaired groups had renal impairment due to non-malignant conditions and the normal group was healthy subjects (population).
